details.title: Data details
details.accountIntro: The export is a JSON file prepared for the signed-in account.
details.accountBody: The export includes your account profile; supported synced learning records such as the active track, goals and learning plans, completed session summaries and results, attempts, and review queue; and linked content reports. Account activity and context include track access, entitlements, legal acceptances, purchase confirmations, consumer cases, device metadata, sync metadata, and export history. Access information explains purposes, data categories, recipients, retention, sources, transfers, automated decisions, and your rights. The manifest names included and omitted categories; credentials, secrets, raw provider or device identifiers, other people's reports, and anonymous reports are not included. Active sessions, drafts, settings, and other device-only data are not synced. After you sign in to the same account, normal sync can restore supported records from the account cloud. Guest-data adoption is a separate choice that merges eligible progress from this device into the account. The JSON is shared through the system share or save sheet for access and portability and cannot be imported into Patternly. For security, you may need to confirm your identity again. Exports are rate limited.
details.guestIntro: You do not need an account to contact us about your data.
details.guestBody: You can remove data stored only on this device locally. Send a broader privacy request through the public support channel. The app does not attach an account identifier or check whether an address exists in the system.
